title: A prespecified betting test of panmixia against a two-deme history: size and power
abstract: This entry formalizes a prespecified fixed-sample test, based on independent blocks of three linked sites observed at three sampled tips with four allelic states, of a panmictic null model against a two-deme alternative. Under the null, the three-tip genealogy follows the coalescent with a time-varying pair-coalescence rate r, and sites mutate under the four-state equal-rates model with scale k. For every nonnegative locally integrable rate r whose integrated clock diverges and every k > 0, the rejection probability with at least 72,000,000,000 independent blocks is at most 1/20. For one specific two-island alternative, with all three tips sampled in the same deme, the rejection probability is at least 4/5 with exactly 72,000,000,000 blocks and at least 19/20 with exactly 250,000,000,000 blocks. The test, its features, its betting factors, its localization tolerance, and its threshold are fixed numerical choices given in the Challenge.
